bullets.text: AI-Driven Business Growth - **Microsoft** empowers organizations to unlock creativity and innovation through AI integration in daily operations.
Enhanced AWS Defense - **Microsoft Sentinel UEBA** enriches AWS logs with behavioral insights for faster anomaly detection.
Scaling Sovereign Cloud - **Azure Local** now supports thousands of nodes, enabling larger workloads within sovereign environments.
Strengthened Microsoft-OpenAI Partnership - An amended agreement enhances collaboration and AI platform development between **Microsoft** and **OpenAI**.
Windows Update Improvements - **Microsoft** enhances user control over updates, addressing feedback for a smoother experience.
New Windows Insider Channels - Transitioning to **Experimental** and **Beta** channels for improved user experiences in Windows.
GPT-5.5 Launch in Foundry - **OpenAI's** latest model is now available in **Microsoft Foundry**, enhancing enterprise AI capabilities.
LangChain.js Course - A free course from **Microsoft** teaches building agentic AI apps with JavaScript.
Securing Agent Tool Execution - **Microsoft** introduces governance for the Model Context Protocol to enhance security in AI tools.
Advancing R&D with Microsoft Discovery - **Microsoft Discovery** expands access to agentic AI capabilities for research and development.
